item.title: Code trace: map all auto_mode references before run/auto merge
item.intent: Before merging run and auto, trace every reference to auto_mode, the internal _auto flag, and auto_scope to understand exactly which conditionals branch on the run/auto split — prevents blind refactoring of the critical sprint loop
steps: grep -n auto_mode .aishore/aishore and document every conditional that checks it
grep -n _auto .aishore/aishore and document the internal flag flow
Map which behaviors activate only in auto mode: auto-groom, circuit breaker, session limit, priority filtering
Write the exact planned diff as comments before making changes
Document findings in the FEAT-065 grooming notes
acceptanceCriteria: Every auto_mode reference is documented with its purpose
The planned merge approach is written out before any code changes
